title: row.set@4
description: One row of the list every reader shows (#1463), a running job's row among them (#1925), and a working session's with what its turn is doing now (#2021), and the one flag a session row shows beside its word (#2019): the app's list, deep, deep status, deep inbox and deep_drive's see read these rows and no other reading. The core builds each row in one place and appends this kind when the row changes, or with listed false when it leaves the list. It is read from the record and is never evidence.

writer.description: Only the core appends this kind.

actor.description: The person behind it, from the credential.

seq.description: Order within the session: ns since the epoch when the hook started.

log_pos.description: Its position in the event log, assigned by the hub at append.

id.description: The row's ID, the id its node carries in the app's tree (#1459): ask:<ULID> for an ask, session:<ID> for a session, job:<key> for a running job by its key (#1925).

listed.description: Whether the row is in the list; false when it left it, and then no other field is read.

order.description: Where the row sits in the list: every reader sorts the rows by this key's bytes, so the list has one order.

address.description: The row's page: ask/<ULID> or session/<ID>; a running job's row has none.

title.description: What the row is called: an ask's question, a session's task, or for an untitled session its agent, never an ID.

project.description: The repo the row's session works in, by its folder's name; null when the record names none.

session.description: The session the row is, or the session that raised the ask.

entry.description: The word's status-map entry, which a mark draws.

x-closure.closed: the status map's entries, each a mark the look draws
x-closure.reopens: a minor that adds an entry to the status map

word.description: The word every surface names the row's state with, from the states table; running for a job whose tool is running (#1925).

x-closure.closed: the words of States people see
x-closure.reopens: a minor that adds a word to that table

why.description: Why the row is in its state, with no age in it: a reader says how long from since.

waits_on.description: Who the row waits on: you or the agent, and a person once the hub names people; null when nothing waits.

since.description: Since when the row is in its state, ms since the Unix epoch; null when the record gives no time.

answer.description: The option an answer gives, as deep inbox answer takes it.

actions.description: What you can do from the row: an ask's answers.

unread.description: Whether the row changed since you last read it (#1461): a first sighting is read unless it ended flagged or stuck.

default.description: An ask's default: the label of the option it takes if you don't answer.

default_at.description: When an ask takes its default, ms since the Unix epoch.

progress.description: A running job's count from its tool's own counter, such as 300 of 600 or 42%, with its time left once the job has run 30 s, such as 300 of 600 · 40 s left (#1925). Absent when its tool reports no counter: a reader shows how long it has run from since.

doing.description: What a working session's turn is doing now (#2021), built only from the hook facts of its latest tool event: the step's words, a verb in its tense and its object, such as Running npm; when that event came, ms since the Unix epoch; and whether the step is over, so a reader writes 2 min ago after it rather than how long it has run. Absent when no tool event of the turn says.

flag.description: The one flag a session row shows in its right slot beside its word (#2019): never a state, at most one, the first that applies in the order interrupted, retrying, repeating, watch-only, unpushed; absent when none applies.

x-closure.closed: the flags a row can carry beside its word
x-closure.reopens: a minor that adds a flag

text.description: The one line its slot shows, from record facts, with no age in it: a reader says how long from since.

since.description: Since when the flag applies, ms since the Unix epoch; null when the record gives no time.

fix.description: What clears it, where something you can do does.

doing.description: interrupted: what its turn last ran, the command or the MCP tool.

until.description: interrupted: when it can pick up, ms since the Unix epoch, as the agent's own record of the limit names it.

cause.description: retrying: the cause the agent's retry record names, in words.

count.description: retrying: the retries so far; repeating: the alike failures in a row.

command.description: repeating: the command, or the MCP server and tool, that failed alike.
